The '''Iron Mine''' was an abandoned [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] mine in the [[Talcim Cluster/Legends|Talcim Cluster]] that had been turned into a secret weapon research facility by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The facility was attacked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
